canonical_project: State CED - Ufficio Informatica, Tecnologia, Dati e Statistica (public-administration data processing office)
notes: Institutional lead (grade C): the state's data processing office (formerly 'Ufficio programmazione economica e centro elaborazione dati e statistica', now Ufficio Informatica, Tecnologia, Dati e Statistica) manages the public administration's IT infrastructure and is located at Via XXVIII Luglio 192, Borgo Maggiore. Internal government CED - no public facility specs; not a commercial colocation data center.
